scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c green,blue "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c green,blue "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
scripts.serve:coolify: npm run build:prod && npm run start:all
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix backend && npm run lint:fix --prefix frontend
